[[Keelyvine Reus]] flew a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|'''Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor''']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Keelyvine_Delta-7B.png|thumb|left|180px|Reus battling Separatist forces over Ukio]]
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Keelyvine Reus flew this green marked Delta-7B [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] with her [[Arfour|R4 unit]] during the [[battle of Ukio]]. She, her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] inspected the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] planetary [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] and its main [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], when [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Fisto and Reus went to their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fighters to do a quick recon in the area the Separatist ship was seen. They saw a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] launching dozens of modified [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]] into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Ukio.
